message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local file path via pd.read_csv with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only filters null/empty labels and casts to int; there is no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected label set, or use of label-noise detection tools.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Data preparation only removes nulls, empty strings, and applies text normalization; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering mechanisms.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle.load to deserialize models and saves/loads artifacts via save_to_pickle/read_pickle without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: The code filters null/empty labels and text in preprocess_data but performs no class balance check or expected-label-set validation before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: Although the code references 'adversarial examples' in make_dataset.py (get_adversarial_examples, get_modified_data), these are data-augmentation constructs (injected text modifications), not robustness stress tests using frameworks like Foolbox, ART, FGSM, or PGD attacks against the model.

No detected metric tampering protection: The pipeline uses separate train/test splits and multiple metrics (accuracy, F1, classification_report), but there is no signing, hashing, or isolation mechanism to protect against metric manipulation or test-set leakage.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model prediction outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or threshold sanity after inference.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML models (LR, SVM, CNN) and rule-based classifiers, not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
